overview: Docket (1934-39) indexes Navy requests to monitor Japanese shipping concentrations and strategic imports, Kobe's reporting, McClintock's rated merchant-fleet study, and Japanese vessels (fishing boats, tankers) tracked in Liberian, Mexican, Haitian, and U.S. ports.

subfiles.title: List of Papers, sheet 1: Japanese shipping concentration and Kobe reporting
subfiles.about: This index sheet summarizes 1934 correspondence concerning the concentration and monitoring of Japanese merchant shipping.
subfiles.summary: Sheet 1: Navy requests on Japanese shipping concentration and strategic imports; State prefers attaché and Kobe consular reporting instead.

subfiles.title: List of Papers, sheet 2: Strategic merchant fleet and overseas vessel movements
subfiles.doc_type: list of papers / file index and cross-reference sheet
subfiles.about: This index sheet covers the strategic assessment of Japan’s merchant fleet and reports or cross-references concerning Japanese vessels in Liberia, Mexico, Haiti, and nearby ports.
subfiles.summary: Sheet 2: McClintock's rated 1934 merchant-fleet study, the Alaska Maru in Liberia, Ensenada fishing-boat reports, and 1938 ship telegrams.

subfiles.title: List of Papers, sheet 3: Japanese tanker traffic from Mexico
subfiles.doc_type: list of papers / file index and cross-reference sheet
subfiles.about: This sheet indexes reports on Japanese tankers exporting Mexican crude oil from Tuxpan to Japan.
subfiles.summary: Sheet 3: a 1939 Daniels telegram on a tanker's Poza Rica crude shipment, and Toei Maru's Yokohama run via Panama.

interest: Shows 1934-39 consular shipping reports feeding naval intelligence on Japan's merchant fleet and Mexican oil shipments.
